title: Typed FIELD/FIELDLIST callback capture bounds
mode: Local implementation slice with generated fast tests
scope: Bound adapter-owned typed DRW_Field and DRW_FieldList callback copies.
Account for field values, nested values, strings, binary payloads, and reference vectors.
Preserve independent raw-carrier identity, owner-graph, and serializer gates.

limits.lifetime: dx_data container lifetime; prior failure and counters are not reset for appended imports

behavior: Typed FIELD/FIELDLIST estimates include table-entry metadata, field strings, CadValue variants and strings, binary data, child keys/slots, and handles.
Counters advance only after successful typed-list insertion; allocation and budget failure are sticky.
Tracked DXF receipts record typed callback/item/byte totals and reject stale generations.
DXF export refuses typed or raw FIELD/FIELDLIST capture failures before output publication.
Raw companion accounting and typed/raw identity-owner pairing remain separate.
